The archive's study of the jealousy reading (#1752) sets out the record: - **The maker in antiquity.** Longinus quotes the poem to show how a maker works: she is "δεινὴ καὶ ἐκλέξαι καὶ εἰς ἄλληλα συνδῆσαι" (10.1), terrible at selecting and binding the extremes together.
